# dn

> Tools for markdown parsing and generation

- [dn.ebook](_autosummary/dn.ebook.html.md): Convert ebook formats (EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, LIT, …) to markdown.
- [dn.ocr](_autosummary/dn.ocr.html.md): Read text out of PDFs that have no text layer, by OCR.
- [dn.repair](_autosummary/dn.repair.html.md): Markdown repair and cleanup utilities.
- [dn.src](_autosummary/dn.src.html.md): Converting things to markdown
- [dn.to](_autosummary/dn.to.html.md): Converting markdown to other formats
- [dn.util](_autosummary/dn.util.html.md): General utilities for dn
